Centurum is seeking a high-aptitude, detail-oriented Data Scientist I to support critical technical and programmatic initiatives across the Commercial Broadband Satellite Program (CBSP) and Satellite Terminal (transportable) Non-Geostationary (STtNG) projects
In this dual-focus role, you will bridge the gap between technical SATCOM system performance and business-side project execution. You will apply modern data science workflows, statistical modeling, database design, and business intelligence (BI) tooling to extract meaningful operational insights from large, complex datasets. In addition to technical program analysis you will work closely with project leadership to ingest, normalize, and analyze internal project tracking data, translating fragmented cost, schedule, deliverable, and milestone metrics into interactive dashboards, predictive models, and executive reporting products.
This position is ideal for an ambitious recent graduate or early-career data scientist with strong foundational skills in Python, SQL, Power Platform, and data visualization who thrives at the intersection of defense communications technology and project intelligence.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Technical Data Science & Engineering Analysis
• Ingest, clean, validate, and structure complex operational, field-test, and engineering datasets associated with CBSP and STtNG systems.

• Design and execute reproducible exploratory data analysis (EDA), regression models, correlation analysis, and statistical hypothesis testing to evaluate RF link availability, throughput, tracking stability, and terminal reliability trends.

• Apply data mining, clustering, natural language processing (NLP), and basic machine learning workflows to identify operational anomalies, maintenance drivers, and failure patterns in satellite terminal hardware and software.

• Support software integration and data pipeline testing, including drafting and executing verification scripts, data quality checks, and automated test procedures.

Business & Project Data Analytics
• Partner with project managers, systems engineers, and financial analysts to analyze internal project data, including resource allocation, deliverable timelines, milestone completion, and fielding schedules.

• Consolidate disparate and siloed spreadsheets into cohesive, normalized data structures suitable for repeatable business tracking.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and trend variances across program milestones to provide proactive decision-support analytics to leadership.

• Design and execute descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses on project records to forecast schedule risk and optimize operational workflows.

Data Architecture, ETL & Pipeline Development
• Develop and optimize relational database schemas (SQL) to normalize legacy, unformatted, or multi-year historical datasets.

• Build lightweight Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) data pipelines to automate recurring data ingestion from various program repositories, testing logs, and project tracking files.

• Implement robust data quality assurance (QA) protocols to ensure data integrity, auditability, and governance across all reporting pipelines.

Business Intelligence, Dashboarding & Data Storytelling
• Build dynamic, interactive dashboards and self-service reporting tools using Power Platform (Power BI).

• Transform dense, tabular reporting formats into intuitive, visually compelling charts, heatmaps, timelines, and drill-down metrics tailored for government stakeholders and executive decision-makers.

• Synthesize technical analytical findings into clear written documentation, slide presentations, and data narratives for non-technical leadership.

REQUIRED SKILLS/YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.

• Experience: Zero (0) to two (2) years of professional, internship, or substantive academic project experience in data analytics, data science, or database design.

• Programming & Scripting: Demonstrated proficiency writing clean, modular code in Python and/or R for data wrangling, transformation, and statistical computation.

• Relational Databases & Querying: Hands-on experience writing SQL queries (joins, aggregations, CTEs, subqueries) and working with relational database environments.

• Statistical Methods: Solid academic foundation in probability, descriptive/inferential statistics, regression modeling, and correlation analysis.

• Clearance & Citizenship: Candidates must be U.S. Citizens with an active DoD Secret clearance or the eligibility and willingness to undergo a federal background investigation to obtain one.

Travel Required : 5%
Work Location : San Diego, CA

PREFERRED SKILLS
• Proven experience overhauling manual, spreadsheet-heavy workflows by structuring data into normalized SQL databases or automated pipelines.

• Demonstrated hands-on project experience with Power BI (data modeling, star schema design, DAX calculated measures, Power Query data transformation).

• Familiarity with data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Altair, Plotly).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate methodology, caveats, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional teams.

REMARKS
Must be able to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
Must be able to interface effectively with all levels of technical and management personnel.
